model: Each cluster count badge sampled the moving map through backdrop-filter: blur(2px). The badge stays opaque at rgba(0,0,0,0.75). The filter is gone, so pan no longer resamples the tiles under the badge.

noise.rule: 60 frames times the badge count. Regional centers are 18 and Seoul districts are 25; empty regions are not drawn, so a live frame is at or under that ceiling. Not a sampled compositor trace.
